paragraphs.text: David distrusts God's protection and therefore flees to the idolaters, who were enemies to God's people.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: perish one day by the hand

paragraphs.text: Thus God by his providence changes the enemies hearts, and makes them favour his in their need.

paragraphs.text: Let your officers appoint me a place.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: These were the wicked Canaanites, whom God had appointed to be destroyed.
